change.request: Create a root tracing span for each provisioning job and wire the tracer into the concurrent job driver.
change.summary: Start a root span for each provisioning job (grafana/grafana #137251)

unknowns: Whether job attributes such as namespace/name/action are added as span attributes.
Whether the change requires updates to the OpenTelemetry tracer provider configuration in pkg/infra/tracing.
Whether the change requires updates to the tracing package or only uses the existing tracing.Start helper.
Whether the historical PR added tracing instrumentation to the worker loop in concurrent_driver.go or only to processKey in driver.go.
Whether the root span name and attributes follow the existing Grafana tracing conventions for provisioning jobs.
Whether the root span name follows the existing "provisioning.jobs.claim_and_process_one_job" convention or a new per-job span name.
Whether the span context must be propagated into worker goroutines or repository operations.

risks.rationale: Starting a root span per job without ensuring it is ended on all error paths could leak spans and distort distributed traces.
Creating a root span for every provisioning job adds tracing overhead to the hot job-processing path and could increase latency under high job throughput.
If the root span context is not propagated to downstream worker operations, child spans may be orphaned and tracing continuity broken.
